## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Northern-Wèi translation of the *Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā* by Bodhiruci 菩提流支. Signature: 「元魏天竺三藏菩提流支譯」. The Taishō header cross-references all the *Vajracchedikā* translations in the canon: [T220](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0001)(9), [T235](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0023), [T236b](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0025), [T237](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0026), [T238](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0027), [T239](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0028), and [K016 / Xuánzàng's](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0029).

**Abstract**

T236a is the second oldest Chinese translation of the *Diamond Sūtra*, after [Kumārajīva's T235](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0023). The translation falls within Bodhiruci's documented Luòyáng period (508–527). T236a is somewhat more literal than T235 and was used as the textual basis for Bodhiruci's translation of *[Vasubandhu's Vajracchedikā-śāstra (T1511)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0032)* — the principal Yogācāra commentary on the *Diamond Sūtra*.

The Taishō encodes T236 as two separate sub-recensions (236a and 236b) reflecting two slightly different transmitted versions in the canonical traditions; both are Bodhiruci's translation in marginally different textual states.
